title: File:GleyClay.jpg
author: Plorpy2
description: Demonstration of soil redox causing gley colors in soil. The clay on the right is exposed to air and oxidized, showing reddish color. The soil on the left is the same clay, but kept in anerobic sealed glass jar for two weeks, causing redox, leading to gley coloring.
